PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.3 — Native click-to-bind menu key, resizable HUD and ore guidance.
PluginData.Description: Learned ore search, configurable pings, optional SDX2 estimates and approximate nearby deposits. MENU KEY in the native footer supports click, key press, CLEAR and APPLY without opening legacy settings. Preserves 1.0.2 HUD resizing and automatic overlay shutdown. Search starts off each launch. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
